description: Dept. of Local Government - Eastern Province - By-laws at Seruwila, Kautale, Gomarakadawala, Muttur and Tambalagama P/S
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval and publication of new by-laws for the Seruwila Pradeshiya Sabha. These by-laws establish regulatory frameworks for advertising, hotels, bakeries, businesses, and beauty centers within the local authority area. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - creating new local regulations, licensing requirements, and compliance procedures - rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
